rationale.3fb0f94e: Ababen hawan jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi har yanzu suna tafiya a sassan titi, don haka mafi ƙanƙantar tram yana aiki a mahaɗai; sassan da aka ware suna amfani da rabin diamita da ake ba da shawara.
rationale.3fed42db: NCHRP Report 716 ba shi da manufar makaranta; tafiye-tafiyen makaranta sun fi gajarta fiye da sauran tafiye-tafiyen gida, don haka ana amfani da raguwa mafi sauri fiye da gida–wasu. t shine lokaci na gaba ɗaya tsakanin yankuna (logsum na zaɓin hanyar sufuri, a mintunan cikin abin hawa).
rationale.40655116: TSI ENE: 25 kV 50 Hz ake fi so don sabon sanya wutar lantarki a babban layi; ana iya riƙe tsare-tsaren ƙasa da ke akwai.
rationale.407d832f: Matsayin mataki na TSI PRM: mataki na farko bai wuce 160 mm ƙasa da dandamali ba. Sashen doka (a duba).
rationale.40f4a87f: DB Ril 819.0202: nisan tsaro bayan alama 50 m ga gudun shiga har zuwa 40 km/h. Layukan metro masu na'urorin tsayar da jirgi (train stops) galibi suna amfani da gajerun nisan tsaro da aka ƙididdige. Sashen doka (a duba).
rationale.415fae19: Nazari ɗaya ne, don haka sakamakon da ke amfani da shi ana yi musu alama a matsayin na nuni. EIR na gondola na Placer County (2019, sashe 4.9) ya auna 69.6 dB(A) Leq da 73.5 dB(A) Lmax a 54 ft (16.5 m) daga tashar tushe ta kujerar kebul mai cirewa (Far East Express, Ascent Environmental 2015) yayin da akwatunan ke shiga a kan layukan jagora da babbar ƙafa (bullwheel). A matsayin tushe na wuri ɗaya a kan ƙasa mai tauri (Lw = Lp + 20 log10 r + 8; canzawar MobSimLab) wannan shine 102 dB(A) daga Leq (tsakiya) da 106 dB(A) daga Lmax (sama). Ƙasa: hasashen EIR na kansa na 56.3 dB(A) Leq a 175 ft (53.3 m) yana ba da 99 dB(A). EIR ya ce injinan gondola na gama-gari ne, don haka ƙimar na kowane tsarin kebul ne har sai wani tushe ya bambanta su.
rationale.41caf5a3: Layin da mai tsari ya yi masa alama a matsayin mai sake amfani da gini da ke akwai (kamar tsohon ramin layin dogo): gyaran bango, magudanar ruwa, iska, kariyar wuta da masu ɗauka maimakon sabon gini. Kimanin kashi ɗaya cikin bakwai na sabon ramin haƙa da rufewa; ƙima mai girma ga gine-ginen da aka daɗe ba a amfani da su ko da suka lalace.
rationale.420f213a: Jiragen ƙasa na masu zuwa aiki a cikin kundin bayani suna da ƙasa 780–1100 mm; jiragen ƙasa masu ƙasan ƙasa da aka gina don dandamali 550 ko 760 mm suna da kimanin 600–800 mm.
rationale.4212f119: TSI ENE ga sababbin layukan jirgin ƙasa mai sauri.
rationale.42a409ce: Cornell/TCAT yana ba da rahoton ƙaruwar a −12 zuwa 10 °C; sama da kimanin 12–15 °C tasirin ƙarami ne.
rationale.43228c20: Darajar lokaci tana ƙaruwa da ainihin GDP ga kowane mutum, da sassauci na kimanin 0.7–1; 1 % a shekara yana daidai da ƙaruwar dogon lokaci ta 1–1.5 % a shekara a yawancin ƙasashe.
rationale.432bc3fc: Gajerun tazarar lokaci a metro da jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi suna barin sarari kaɗan; 20 s yana sa tazarar lokaci ta 2-minute ta yiwu.
rationale.4333e2d6: 50 m shine rabin diamita na mahaɗar titi da aka saba; 25 m ga gareji da madauki, 100 m a layin da aka ware.
rationale.437774fb: Nazarin Martens kan keke da sufurin jama'a a Netherlands, Germany da United Kingdom: yawancin fasinjoji suna hawan keke 1 zuwa 3 km zuwa tasha, kaɗan fiye da 5 km. Tashoshi masu wurin ajiye keke a kusa kawai (OpenStreetMap amenity=bicycle_parking) ake iya kaiwa ta wannan hanya.
rationale.44f37b20: Ga kowane jirgin ƙasa mai ƙarfin kansa.
rationale.453febd8: 200 km/h tare da gefen jin daɗi.
rationale.46430597: Layin dogon birni galibi yana aiki kowane 2–5 min a lokacin cunkoso don haka fasinjoji ba sa buƙatar jadawali.
rationale.4663ffcb: Jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi masu ƙasan ƙasa da tram-train a cikin kundin bayani suna da ƙasa 356–550 mm; ababen hawan Stadtbahn masu tsayin ƙasa (Stuttgart DT 8) suna da 1000 mm.
rationale.46c150f1: TSI PRM: mataki na tsaye ≤ 50 mm a kowace alƙibla (an gani a tushe); ADA: ± 5/8 in (≈ 16 mm) ga layin dogo mai sauri da mai sauƙi (a duba).
rationale.46dd4c61: MUTCD 2009 § 8C.04: hannayen shinge suna tashi zuwa tsaye cikin ba fiye da 12 s ba bayan jirgin ƙasa ya wuce kuma ba a gano wani jirgi ba; fitilun suna tsayawa idan hannayen sun tashi. Shinge da ke tashi cikin kimanin 6–10 s abu ne na yau da kullum a wasu wurare. Ƙimar tsakiya tana tsakanin biyun.
rationale.46e1b5df: Tsarin tafiyar Tobler: gudun tafiya a ƙafa shi ne 6 exp(-3.5 |s + 0.05|) km/h a kan gangare s, mafi sauri a gangaren ƙasa na 5 %. Mai tsara tafiya yana riƙe gudun tafiya a fili kuma yana ninka lokacin da exp(k (|s + 0.05| - 0.05)); s shi ne bambancin tsayi tsakanin ƙarshen biyu raba nisan tafiya, an iyakance shi cikin ±50 %. 3.5 ƙimar Tobler ce; kewayon ±0.5 ƙiyasi ne. 0 yana watsi da gangare.
rationale.472c7331: Ababen hawan metro masu tsayin ƙasa.
rationale.47a4908b: Broach, Dill da Gliebe: layukan da aka fenta suna taimakawa ƙasa da hanyoyi daban, kuma galibi a tituna masu cunkoso. OpenStreetMap cycleway=lane ko layin keke da aka saita a shafin GIS (saitin titi).
rationale.47ac0bc3: CBTC da ETCS level 2 suna riƙe gefen tsaro bayan lanƙwasar birki don rufe rashin tabbas na wuri da ƙarshen jirgin ƙasan gaba; masu samarwa suna amfani da mita goma-goma kaɗan.
rationale.47e02ea1: Layin matakin ƙasa yana cikin ko kusa da saman titi. Har zuwa kimanin mita ɗaya na bambanci ana iya ɗauka ta hanyar sake daidaita titi da hanyoyin ƙafa da ke kusa da shi (gefen titi 0.1–0.2 m ne, gangare a 6 % yana rufe mita ɗaya a kimanin 17 m). Bayan haka titi, mahaɗansa da ƙofofin shigarsa suna buƙatar sake gini, wanda ya kamata mai tsari ya gani. Ana kuma amfani da shi ga tashar matakin ƙasa, inda ƙasa za ta iya faɗuwa ninki biyu na wannan a tsawon dandamali.
rationale.484c4f1e: EN 13803 da EBO §6: 130 mm na yau da kullum da 150 mm tare da sharuɗɗa ga ababen hawa na gargajiya; jiragen ƙasa masu karkata sun fi haka. Sashen doka (a duba).
rationale.496629d4: Tram masu tafiya a titi suna bin bayanin titi; mita ɗari kaɗan abu ne na yau da kullum a ƙoli da kwari (a duba adadin da BOStrab-TrR).
rationale.4975686b: Ana amfani da shi ne kawai inda ba za a iya loda tarin WorldPop ba: mutane a gini = faɗin ƙasan gini × benaye ÷ wannan ƙima. Gidaje a yammacin Turai suna ba da kusan 40 zuwa 50 m² na wurin zama ga kowane mutum; jimillar faɗin ƙasan gini (bango, matakala, wurare na gama-gari, amfanin bene na ƙasa) ya fi kimanin kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu. Gine-ginen da aka yi wa alama a OSM a matsayin wani amfani (shago, ofis, gareji, coci…) ba sa samun mazauna.
rationale.4987e8c9: Masu gudanarwa suna tsarawa bisa tagar cajin batir mai amfani kuma suna riƙe ajiya don karkacewa, zirga-zirga da tsufan batir; 20 % na ƙimar suna adadin tsari ne da aka saba.
rationale.4aa6a5c7: Tashar BRT a rufe tare da dandamali da karɓar kuɗin mota a waje da abin hawa.
rationale.4ac188fa: Tashoshi kaɗan a kowane gari; garuruwan da ake hidima ne ke saita nisa tsakanin tashoshi maimakon isa da ƙafa.
rationale.4b8ed820: Runduna masu yawan amfani tare da gyara da dare.
rationale.4d6a42db: Tafiya da gani dole ta ba da damar tsayawa a cikin nisan da ake gani (BOStrab); ya fi na ababen hawan titi tsawo saboda ƙarancin birkin yau da kullum.
rationale.4e15587c: 4 % a ainihin ƙima ma'aunin kwatanci ne da aka saba don ribar kuɗi ta kayayyakin more rayuwa na jama'a (Jagorar CBA ta Hukumar Turai (European Commission), 2014, tana amfani da shi); a saita ƙimar da masu ba da kuɗinka ke nema. Zaɓinka ne — ana riƙe shi tsayayye a gudanarwar Monte Carlo.
rationale.4e174e85: Dogo na uku na 750 V DC shi ne ya fi yawa; wayar sama ta 1500 V DC ko dogo na uku na 1500 V DC mai rufi a wasu tsare-tsare.
rationale.4e38d890: WHO 2018: hayaniyar zirga-zirgar titi ƙasa da 45 dB L_night.
rationale.4ebebef5: Tsayin ƙasa yana zuwa daga Copernicus GLO-30, samfurin saman ƙasa a kan tarin 30 m wanda ya haɗa da gine-gine da bishiyoyi, tare da 'yan mita na hayaniyar tsaye. Tsakiya mai gudana (running median) a kan 100 m tana cire duk abin da ya fi kimanin 50 m siriri (gini ko jerin bishiyoyi da layin ke wucewa), kuma matsakaici mai gudana a kan taga ɗaya tana cire sauran hayaniyar. Tagar gajera ce idan aka kwatanta da tsawon lanƙwasar tsaye (mita ɗari da yawa a rabin diamita na 2,000 m), don haka ainihin canje-canjen gangare suna zama a bayanin. Taga mafi faɗi tana ɓoye ƙarin hayaniya da ƙarin ainihin ƙasa.
rationale.4f16c151: Dandamali mafi tsawo fiye da na tram.
rationale.4f366b1d: CNOSSOS-EU Annex II 2.3.2 (hayaniyar iska): yana da muhimmanci ne kawai sama da 200 km/h. Ana ƙara ƙimomin Teburi G-6 a tushe A da B da alpha 50 (L_W = L_W,0 + 50 lg(v/300)).
rationale.4f979869: Nisa tsakanin tashoshin jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi yana ƙaruwa da kason haƙƙin hanya da aka ware (Vuchic, rukuni B).
rationale.508c6b3e: Direba da ma'aikatan cikin abin hawa.
rationale.51786f6c: 09 §2.1: tazarar kwatanci ƙasa da 1 %. Ana auna ta a matsayin jimillar cikakkun canje-canje a jadawalin tafiye-tafiyen mota bisa jimillarsa; ana samun matsakaicin jadawalan zagaye masu bin juna (hanyar matsakaita masu bin juna).
rationale.517ed631: Kimanin 1:450 ake ba da shawara da 1:400 a matsayin iyaka a layi mai tsakuwa (EN 13803, a duba). Tsawo = karkatarwa / gangare.
rationale.51a9f870: Tituna suna ɗauke da ƙimomin cunkoso kawai (lokutan cunkoso a shafin GIS), don haka gudanarwar tsakar rana da ta dare suna sikelin su. Bayanan awa-awa na ranar aiki a birni suna sa awar tsakar rana a kusan 5–6 % na zirga-zirgar rana idan aka kwatanta da 8–10 % a awar cunkoso (HCM K-factors), kimanin 0.6 na cunkoso; daren baya ya fi ƙasa, don haka a saita ƙimarka ga gudanarwar dare.
rationale.5351f266: Manyan sassan tsakiya (misali ramukan S-Bahn) suna kai kimanin 120 s.
rationale.538283d3: Matsayin mataki na TSI PRM: mataki na farko bai wuce 230 mm sama da dandamali ba. Sashen doka (a duba).
rationale.5488af84: TSI INF yana ba da izinin har zuwa 35 ‰ a layukan jirgin ƙasa mai sauri na fasinjoji kaɗai, tare da iyakoki kan tsawon sassa masu gangare (a duba sashen doka).
rationale.54af6aa6: Mutane sun fi son tafiya da ƙafa inda babu zirga-zirga. Yana aiki ga OpenStreetMap highway=pedestrian da living_street. Tafiye-tafiye da ƙafa zuwa tashoshi suna riƙe ainihin tsawonsu; lokacin hanyar tafiya da ƙafa kawai ake auna nauyinsa.
rationale.54e0f384: Ma'aikata da makamashi galibi na cikin gida ne.
rationale.55bb16d8: t = t0 · (1 + α (v/c)^β). Ƙimomin Bureau of Public Roads sune α = 0.15 da β = 4; manyan titunan birni masu fitila galibi ana ba su α mafi girma.
rationale.5675dd76: Cikakken 120 km/h ba tare da takunkumi ba (duba mafi ƙanƙanta).
rationale.56fc4779: Fasinjojin shekara galibi ninki 280–330 ne na matsakaicin fasinjojin ranar aiki, domin ƙarshen mako da ranakun hutu suna ɗaukar ƙasa.
rationale.56fda0d9: FTA yana amfani da jagorar 20 % ga layin dogo a matsayin ma'aunin kwatanci; rundunar jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi ƙanana ne, don haka iyakar ta zama ruwan dare.
rationale.578a7a12: Layukan babbar hanya mai layuka da yawa a kwararar 'yanci suna ɗaukar kimanin motoci 2000 zuwa 2400 a awa.
rationale.57e23462: Yankin hidima (mode.catchment_m) shine tafiya da ƙafa da yawancin fasinjoji ke karɓa; wasu suna tafiya nesa fiye da haka inda layi yake da sauri ko yawan tafiya. Ana ba da har zuwa ninki biyu na yankin hidima, kuma nauyin tafiya da ƙafa a zaɓin hanyar sufuri yana sa dogayen tafiye-tafiye da ƙafa marasa jan hankali da kansu.
rationale.57e3d7bf: Gefe don daidaiton direba a gudun tafiya da ƙafa a gareji, a kan iyakar jikin abin hawa (madubai suna naɗewa a kan ababen hawa da aka ajiye); samfuran hanyar da abin hawa ke mamaye galibi ana zana su da 0.3–0.5 m.
rationale.57faf4c6: R = 11.8 v² / (D + I): v = 160 km/h, D = 160, I = 130 yana ba da kimanin 1040 m; ƙimomi mafi ƙanƙanta suna sanya takunkumin gudu na wuri.
rationale.58511936: ITDP People Near Frequent Transit yana ƙirga tashoshin da ake hidima aƙalla kowane minti 15; matakan hidimar yawan tafiya na TCQSM suna sa tazarar lokaci ta 10–14 min da 15–20 min a iyakar da fasinjoji ke daina duba jadawali.
rationale.587e7354: Iyakar jin daɗi ga fasinjoji a tsaye.
rationale.591f6a79: Jikin tarago 2.65–3.10 m tare da girgiza da sarari; nau'in rami ne ya fi tasiri (ramuka biyu daban suna da nisa sosai).
rationale.593119dc: TSI PRM yana buƙatar faɗi mara cikas na aƙalla 1.60 m bayan yankin haɗari; tare da yankin haɗari na kimanin 1.0 m da kayan titi wannan yana ba da kimanin 3.5 m.
rationale.59804381: Isarwa mai raguwa ta exponential mara kyau; β = 0.05/min yana rage nauyin aiki zuwa rabi kowane minti 14, a cikin kewayon da ake amfani da shi don zuwa aiki a nazarin isarwa na Turai.
rationale.59d96cda: Jagorar US DOT tana ƙimanta tafiyar mutum ta cikin gida a 50 % na tsakiyar kuɗin shiga na awa, ko menene manufar.
rationale.59f4a509: Ginin ƙananan benaye na yau da kullum; ana maye shi da building:levels ko height ÷ 3 m inda OSM ke da su.
rationale.59fa380f: 09 §2.1: a maimaita har sai tazarar ta gaza demand.feedback.gap ko har zuwa zagaye 10 mafi yawa.
rationale.5acd7115: Kowane tram ko abin hawan jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi yana da ƙarfin kansa.
rationale.5b2090be: Bas dole ya juya a cikin da'ira mai rabin diamita na waje 12.5 m (diamita 25 m, 96/53/EC); bas na 12 m a cikin kundin bayani suna ambaton kimanin 19–22 m. Binciken hanyar da abin hawa ke mamaye yana amfani da ƙimar abin hawan kansa inda kundin bayani yake da ita.
rationale.5cafc81f: Zafin layin dogo yana bin rana kuma yana kai ƙoli da rana (bayan azahar).
rationale.5cb64359: Iyakokin gudun birni (50 km/h a yawancin Turai) suna iyakance gudun hidima; iyakar titin kansa ce ke aiki.
rationale.5cd5bb5a: Rabin faɗin abin hawa (2.40–2.65 m) tare da gibi na kwance na kimanin 50 mm don hawa a daidaice.
rationale.5d016461: BRT galibi yana amfani da bas masu haɗin gwiwa na 18 m masu kujeru kimanin 40 zuwa 50 da 60 zuwa 100 a tsaye a yawan tsari.
rationale.5d257f3b: Galibi ana isa tasha ta wasu hanyoyin sufuri; yankin hidimar tafiya da ƙafa yana iyakance kason tafiya da ƙafa kaɗai ne kawai.
rationale.5ddc71eb: Layin dogon birni yana da gajerun lokutan tsayawa da ke wuce lokaci sau da yawa amma kaɗan; tafiya ɗaya cikin biyar tana farawa a makare.
rationale.5defeb96: Matsakaicin kuɗin hayaniyar mota kimanin 0.5–1 € cents ne a kowace km; ƙimomin gefe na birni da dare sun fi haka ninki da yawa. Waɗannan ƙimomin Turai ne, an canza su daga euro na 2016 da ma'aunin PPP na yankin euro da hauhawar farashin US; a maye su da ƙimomin yankin idan kana da su, domin kuɗin gurɓata, haɗari da cunkoso sun bambanta sosai tsakanin ƙasashe.
rationale.5ec50581: Direba ɗaya; ƙarshen ƙasa ga layukan da babu direba tare da ma'aikata masu yawo.
rationale.5ee8ef5e: NCHRP Report 716 yana ba da ma'aunan gogayya na gamma ga manyan yankunan birni (f = a·t^b·e^(c·t), t a mintuna). Daidaitawa zuwa tsawon tafiya da aka lura yana canza c kuma yana riƙe b.
rationale.5eeec399: Tsohon END Annex I 23:00 ga dare na awa takwas.
rationale.5f5e7337: Directive (EU) 2021/1226, Annex point (4)(b): jiragen ƙasa +5 dB ga lanƙwasa masu 300 m < R ≤ 500 m da aƙalla 50 m na layi.
rationale.5f7b5421: Kwalejoji suna da ɗalibai dubbai kaɗan, manyan jami'o'in birni 20 000 zuwa 40 000 a wurare da dama. A shigar da ainihin adadi a yankin da aka san shi.
rationale.5f7c929e: Metro an ware shi gaba ɗaya bisa ma'ana (rukunin haƙƙin hanya A, galibi da dogo na uku mai wuta). Layukan jirgin ƙasa mai sauri suna tafiya sama da gudun da ake yarda da mahaɗar daidai har zuwa gare shi (EBO § 11(2)).
rationale.5f967098: Transit Costs Project: tashoshi su ne babban abu ɗaya mafi tsada na layukan rami; akwatuna marasa zurfi sun fi arha sosai fiye da tashoshi masu zurfi da aka haƙa.
rationale.5fd92f94: An ware gaba ɗaya; jirgin ƙasa na babban layi na iya riƙe mahaɗar daidai (rukuni B).
rationale.610980b3: Tafiye-tafiye tsakanin aiki, shaguna da ayyuka galibi suna ƙarewa a shaguna da wuraren hidima.
rationale.61bfbf46: Layin dogo mai kwazazzabo a tituna yana tara datti da ruwa; ƙimar tsakiya mafi ƙanƙanta.
rationale.61cf67d4: Kamar manyan tituna, tare da gajerun lokutan kore da ƙarin zirga-zirgar juyawa.
rationale.61def8a3: Ranakun digirin sanyaya galibi ana ƙirga su sama da 22 °C.
rationale.627144d9: Ana loda gine-gine, ƙasa da masu karɓa a cikin wannan nisa daga layuka. 300 m yana rufe rukunin 55 dB L_den na yawancin layukan birni; babban layi mai sauri na iya buƙatar fiye. Ba fiye da noise.max_source_distance_m ba.
rationale.649938ef: Layi ɗaya a kowace hanya shine titin birni da ya fi yawa; OSM lanes=* ne ke aiki idan akwai.
rationale.64e9dd97: Gefen tsaro da ake ƙarawa a bayan ƙarshen jirgin ƙasan gaba a rabewar sashe mai motsi (CBTC); layukan sashe tsayayye suna samun rabewarsu daga sassan block da nisan tsaro bayan alama maimakon haka.
rationale.654e1984: Bitar Fishman: kasancewa kusa da tashar ajiye keke shine mafi ƙarfin alamar amfani da kekunan haɗin gwiwa; yawancin masu amfani suna zaune ko aiki a cikin mita ɗari kaɗan. Tashoshi suna zuwa daga OpenStreetMap (amenity=bicycle_rental).
rationale.6564b12f: Ƙarin ƙima kai tsaye da ta sarkar samarwa a kowace naúrar buƙatar ƙarshe ta cikin gida ta ɗan gaza 1 (Type I, teburan shigarwa da fitarwa); ƙara kashe kuɗin gidaje (Type II) yana ba da kimanin 1.2–1.5.
rationale.659d278c: Dandamali biyu na gefe, rumfuna, injunan tikiti, hawa a daidaice.
rationale.65c2225f: Ɓangaren lokacin mamayewa 'saki': gajere ga haɗin kulle na lantarki masu ƙirgar gatari ko da'irar layi; mafi tsawo ga sakin hannu ko na relay.
rationale.6629fe11: Ma'aunan S-Bahn na Jamus sune 140 m (Berlin) da 210 m (jiragen ƙasa uku na 70 m); wasu tsare-tsare suna amfani da mafi tsawo.
rationale.669965bc: Makamashin ƙarfin jan, gyaran abin hawa da tsaftacewa.
rationale.66c2e872: Tsayayyun ƙimomin samfurin logit suna motsawa da log na kason da aka lura bisa kason samfuri (Ortúzar da Willumsen, babi 8). A samfuri mai gida-gida cikakken mataki na iya wuce gona da iri; rage shi kaɗan yana sa ya natsu.
rationale.66d6fb19: Matsakaicin gudun hawan keke na birni daga ƙofa zuwa ƙofa, tare da jira a mahaɗai a ciki, kamar yadda ake amfani da shi ga nau'in keke na birnin minti 15 (Moreno da sauransu 2021 suna ƙirga wuraren zuwa a cikin minti 15 da ƙafa ko da keke). 12 km/h ƙima ce mai taka-tsantsan ga tsofaffi ko masu hawa lokaci-lokaci, 18 km/h mai zuwa aiki a hanyar sadarwar keke mai sauri. Mashigai masu fitila suna ƙara walk.crossing_delay_s a kai, kamar tafiya da ƙafa.
rationale.682458af: Ƙimomin harajin kadarori na shekara-shekara masu tasiri suna tsakanin kimanin 0.2 % zuwa fiye da 1 % na darajar kasuwa a shekara; kuɗin harajin yanki yana maye gurbin wannan idan an shigar da shi.
rationale.6839ef16: Bas na birni na 12 m; dizal kimanin US$ 0.3 miliyan, mai batir kimanin ninki biyu na haka.
rationale.685f71b3: A lokutan cunkoso ƙarin mutane suna tafiya zuwa tsakiya da safe da kuma nesa da shi da yamma; rabe-raben alƙibla na 55–70 % abu ne na yau da kullum a layuka masu fita daga tsakiya (TCQSM directional peaking). A waje da cunkoso alƙiblu biyu suna ɗaukar daidai, kuma ba a raba layukan madauki.
rationale.68ecdd7c: Ana sanya tashoshi da nisa fiye da tashoshin unguwa don riƙe gudun tafiya sama; tsakanin ƙimomin bas da na jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi.
rationale.695b4ecf: Faɗin bas 2.55 m (Directive 96/53/EC) a layukan ajiye mota na 3.5–4.0 m yana barin kimanin 1.0–1.5 m; madubai suna buƙatar aƙalla kimanin 0.8 m.
rationale.697fecc3: Ranakun Lahadi suna ɗaukar mafi ƙarancin fasinjoji a mako; kewayon yana riƙe ranakun shekara masu daidai da ranar aiki a cikin benefit.ridership.days_per_year (280–330), kamar benefit.ridership.saturday_share.
rationale.6991e903: FTA yana tsammanin ababen hawa na ajiya su kasance a ko ƙasa da 20 % na ababen hawa a mafi girman hidima ga runduna ta 50 ko fiye; 15 % shine tsohon aikin da aka riga aka ambata a FR-PLAT-05.
rationale.69db72ec: 300 km/h tare da ƙarancin karkatarwa da ƙarancin karkatarwa mara isa don jin daɗi da gaurayen gudu; 7000 m abu ne na yau da kullum a layukan 300 km/h.
rationale.69ebc0bc: Al'adar tsari tana neman tazarar kwatanci ta 0.1 % ko mafi kyau a rabawa masu cunkoso.
rationale.6a17286c: Wuraren hidima, ofisoshi da gine-ginen jama'a suma suna jawo baƙi, a ɗan kaso na ƙimar shaguna.
rationale.6a21d176: Ƙiyasin da aka saba: rabin lokacin zuwa tsakiyar yanki mafi kusa.
rationale.6abdb166: Ababen hawa masu faɗi da sauri fiye da tram; turakun tsakiya suna tura zuwa sama.
rationale.6ac5f867: 50 km/h a karkata a 33 m shine sulhun da aka saba ga haɗin tasha da mahaɗa a layukan gargajiya. Mai tsari yana zaɓar kowane abu na switches.yaml; wannan shine tayin farko kawai.
rationale.6cc660ed: Na'urorin caji na gareji masu toshewa da dare ga bas masu batir galibi 40–150 kW ne a kowane abin hawa; 150 kW yana kuma ba da damar ƙarin caji da rana. Na'urorin caji na pantograph suna kai 300 kW ko fiye.
rationale.6d0d7967: 60 km/h a karkata ga madaukan wucewa da maƙogwaron tasha a layukan tsakanin birane.
rationale.6d5644ef: 4.50 m a sababbin layuka har zuwa 300 km/h; TSI INF yana saita mafi ƙanƙanta da ya dogara da gudu (a duba sashen doka).
rationale.6e815c81: CNOSSOS-EU Annex II 2.3.2 (hayaniyar bugu): rashin santsin bugu yana ƙara fitarwa daga 50 m kafin zuwa 50 m bayan haɗin layi ko makunni, a yawan haɗi ɗaya a kowace 100 m (Teburi G-4 makunni/haɗi/mahaɗa guda ɗaya).
rationale.6e8914b2: Layin da aka binne a shimfiɗa yana fitar da sauti fiye da tsakuwa kuma yana haskakawa; layin ciyawa zai fi shiru. CNOSSOS-EU yana lissafa layin da aka binne (lambar tushen layi T, Teburi 2.3.b) amma bai ba da aikin canjawa gare shi a Appendix G ba, don haka ana ƙara wannan gyaran MobSimLab ga fitar sautin layi na aikin canjawa na layi mai tsakuwa.
rationale.6ed75b3c: Tsohon 06-gis §9.3: dandamalin wurin canji ɗaya (tashar tram a gaban tasha, tashoshin bas biyu a kowane gefen mahaɗa) galibi suna cikin kimanin 150 m da juna; idan sun fi nisa tashoshi ne daban da ke buƙatar sunayensu na kansu.
rationale.6f0104d7: Ayyukan ƙasa, magudanar ruwa, ƙananan gine-gine da karkatar da bututu da wayoyi ga dogo biyu da aka ware a matakin ƙasa. Bayanan Transit Costs Project sun nuna layukan matakin ƙasa suna kai ɗan kaso na na rami.
rationale.6f034ac1: Inda layukan nau'o'i daban-daban ke raba hanyar dogo, jirgi mai jinkiri na iya jira a hanyar kaucewa ko wata hanyar dandali don mai sauri ya wuce. Dogayen manyan layuka masu tashoshi masu nisa da juna suna buƙatar jira mai tsawo (minti 15 zuwa 20 a layin gwaji na kilomita 345); a layi mai cunkoso, dogon jira na toshe hanyoyin kaucewa da wasu jiragen ke buƙata.
rationale.6f2166f6: Tram suna tafiya da gani; 'yan mita bayan tasha sun isa.
rationale.6f4b6e31: Rabawar tana tsayawa a wannan ko a demand.road.relative_gap, duk wanda ya zo farko.
rationale.6fc38790: Sufurin jama'a na Netherlands yana karɓar kimanin 0.17–0.20 € a kowace km, layin dogo na yanki da na nesa na Jamus da Switzerland kimanin 0.15–0.30 € a kowace km a cikakken kuɗin mota; ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗin shiga ƙasa da haka.
rationale.7099942d: UIC 406 yana tantance kwanciyar hankali ta hanyar gudanar da jadawali da jinkiri na bazata. Gudanarwa takwas masu iri (seed) sun isa don bambance jadawali mai kwanciyar hankali da wanda jinkiri ke ƙaruwa a ciki, kuma suna riƙe gwajin a matsayin mai hulɗa a mai bincike (browser); a yi amfani da fiye don nazarin da za a wallafa.
rationale.70bee6a1: Minti 45 iyakar zuwa aiki ce da aka saba a nazarin isarwa na damar tarawa (cumulative-opportunity); 30 da 60 sune ƙimomin gwajin hankali da aka saba.
rationale.70c1f4c0: Mamaye wurin tsayawa a tashoshin ƙarshe.
rationale.70fe4c34: Faɗin abin hawa 2.40–2.65 m tare da girgizar motsi da gibin tsaro na kimanin 0.3 m; 3.60 m ko fiye da turakun tsakiya.
rationale.710ea8c2: Kulawar gudun rufi na ETCS: tsoma bakin birkin gaggawa yana kimanin 7.5 km/h sama da gudun da aka yarda a ƙananan gudu kuma yana ƙaruwa da gudu; tsare-tsaren CBTC suna amfani da gefe makamantan haka.
rationale.7240edbb: Tafiyar masu shekarun makaranta babban ɓangare ne na amfani da bas a waje da cunkoso kuma ƙarami a layin dogo.
rationale.72a36db0: Curtius–Kniffler μ = 0.161 + 7.5/(v + 44) yana ba da 0.33 a tsaye a layin dogo bushe; 0.25 ƙimar ƙira ce da aka saba tare da sarrafa zamewar ƙafa; layin dogo mai jiƙe ko mai ganyaye na iya faɗuwa zuwa 0.15 ko ƙasa.
rationale.731f1769: EN 13803 yana ba da shawarar kimanin 50 mm/s ga ƙimar canjin karkatarwa a tsawon lanƙwasar sauyi, tare da mafi girman ƙimomi sama da haka (a duba sashen doka). Tsawo = gudu · karkatarwa / ƙima.
rationale.735cf811: Dogayen dandamali, ɗakunan jira, shiga ba tare da matakala ba.
rationale.739f3c05: Fishman: yawancin tsare-tsare suna sa rabin awar farko kyauta tare da biyan kuɗin rajista, ko suna karɓar kimanin dala ɗaya a kowace tafiya. An canza shi zuwa kuɗin aikin da ma'aunin PPP; a jadawalin sufurin jama'a yana ƙirguwa a matsayin mintuna a darajar lokacin tafiye-tafiyen da ba na aiki ba.
rationale.73e756cd: Faɗin abin hawa tare da girgiza, kamar nisa tsakanin tsakiyoyin layin tram.
rationale.73f9d0e2: Layukan jirgin ƙasa mai sauri a EU suna da ETCS (TSI CCS); Level 2 yana amfani da alamar cikin taksi tare da allunan alamar sashe maimakon alamomin sashe na gefen layi. Tsofaffin layuka suna amfani da alamar cikin taksi ta ƙasa kamar LZB.
rationale.740fffed: Bankin Duniya (World Bank): gadojin sama na HSR mai dogo biyu na China suna kai kimanin RMB 57–73 miliyan a kowace km (US$ 9–12 miliyan, farashin 2014); kuɗaɗen Turai da Arewacin Amurka sun fi haka ninki biyu zuwa biyar.
rationale.7424a565: Cunkoson yamma na yau da kullum daga 16:00 zuwa 19:00 ne.
rationale.750268e6: Jinkirin farko galibi ana yin samfurinsa a matsayin exponential (ƙanana da yawa, manya kaɗan); minti biyu ƙima ce ta matsakaici a babban layi.
rationale.75209f50: Layin da aka binne, wayar sama da tashoshin wuta; ƙarin layukan Jamus suna kai kimanin £9.4 miliyan a kowace km ga layi, tashoshi da wayoyi.
rationale.7544bf00: Ɗaukar keken jarirai ko kaya sama da matakala, neman taimako, ko zuwa wata tasha. Tashoshin da aka rubuta a Create ba tare da shiga ba tare da matakala ba, lif ko gangaren hawa kawai ake ƙirga; tashoshin da ba su da siffofin da aka rubuta ba a ƙirga su. Samfurin yana ƙara kaso sau hukunci ga hawa a can.
rationale.756ad73e: Tafiya a titi tare da wani layi da aka tanada.
rationale.75950aec: Yawancin taragan metro a cikin kundin bayani suna da ƙasa 950–1200 mm (kimanin 1100 mm na yau da kullum); layuka masu ƙaramin girma kamar Glasgow Subway sun fi ƙasa (695 mm).
rationale.75cc3d91: Mutane 4/m² shine nauyin tsari da aka saba ga hidimomin birni; 6 cunkoso ne mai tsanani.
rationale.75d85fb7: Ƙimar farko da ba a daidaita ba, ƙasa saboda mutane kaɗan ne ke mallaka da amfani da keke don tafiye-tafiyen yau da kullum a yawancin birane; daidaitawa zuwa kason hanyoyin sufuri da aka lura yana maye gurbinta.
rationale.7618b7e5: Jurewar edita, ba ƙimar injiniya ba; faɗi isasshe don rufe maƙogwaron tasha, ƙarami isasshe don guje wa layukan da ba su da alaƙa.
rationale.76eb4882: Juyawar bas na birni mai jin daɗi; lanƙwasar wayar sama ta bas mai waya tana son manyan rabin diamita.
rationale.786279ca: Nisa daga yankin karo zuwa layin tsayawa don abin hawa mai jira kada ya toshe mashigar; dokokin titi na yankin ne ke yanke shawara.
rationale.78b2d00b: Ana ƙara shi ga kason tafiye-tafiyen da suka yi jinkiri na gwajin kwanciyar hankali (simulation.stability.delayed_share).
rationale.78e3ec8a: Iyakokin matsayin mataki na TSI PRM ga matakin shiga na farko idan aka kwatanta da dandamali a layi madaidaici, a daidaice: kwance 200 mm. Sashen doka (a duba).
rationale.7966a1df: Tsoffin NMPB-2008 kamar yadda ake amfani da su ga France a manhajojin CNOSSOS; ilimin yanayi na Hungary ya sami kimanin kashi ɗaya cikin uku da rana. Cikakkiyar taswira ce ke amfani da shi; hanyar hayaniya ta edita tana ɗauka yanayi mai kyau a ko'ina (iyakar sama).
rationale.797d1cf4: Rabin minti ya gaza abin da fasinjan metro ke lura da shi a tazarar lokaci ta minti 2–5.
rationale.79c22677: Rabin faɗin jikin tarago (2.80–3.10 m) tare da gibi na kimanin 75 mm (access.level_gap_horizontal_mm).
rationale.79dc09cf: An samo daga R = 11.8 v² / (D + I) tare da v = 120 km/h, D = 160 mm karkatarwa, I = 130 mm ƙarancin karkatarwa yana ba da kimanin 590 m don cikakken gudun layi; 150–300 m shine abin da EMU na babban layi ke karɓa a rage gudu.
rationale.79fcf8ce: Jirgin ƙasa mai sauri na 200 m yana kai kimanin US$ 30–40 miliyan.
rationale.7a391d42: Makarantun firamare suna da ɗalibai kimanin 200 zuwa 400, makarantun sakandare 600 zuwa 1500. OpenStreetMap ba safai ba yake faɗin wanne, don haka ana amfani da ƙima ɗaya ta tsakiya; a shigar da ainihin adadi a yankin da aka san shi.
rationale.7a9784a8: Directive (EU) 2021/1226, Annex point (4)(b), teburin ƙara: jiragen ƙasa +8 dB ga lanƙwasa masu R ≤ 300 m da aƙalla 50 m na layi (da makunnai masu R ≤ 300 m), ana ƙara shi ga hayaniyar birgima a dukkan rukunoni. Ƙasa da sama ƙimomin gwajin hankali ne ga lanƙwasa masu mai da masu ƙara sosai.
rationale.7abad1cd: Neman wuri, kullewa da tafiya da ƙafa zuwa dandamali; fiye da haka a wuraren ajiye keke masu cunkoso ko masu gadi.
rationale.7b0779b3: LRV biyu zuwa huɗu da aka haɗa.
rationale.7b598ece: Tram masu ƙasan ƙasa suna da ƙasa na kimanin 300–350 mm; dandamali suna ɗan ƙasa don ba da damar motsin sasfenshan.
rationale.7c99497d: UIC 406 yana kiran jadawali mai kwanciyar hankali idan jinkiri ya ragu a cikin lokacin; rabin awa bayan lokacin yana ba ƙarin lokutan tafiya da tazara damar shanye su.
rationale.7d2479ec: Kowane layi na biyu yana ba kowane abin hawa hanyar tafiya a gefe ɗaya.
rationale.7e300b0a: Tram mai ƙasan ƙasa na 30–35 m yana kai kimanin US$ 3–5 miliyan.
rationale.7e59dcf4: Sababbin layukan metro da waɗanda aka sake wa alamomi suna amfani da sarrafa jirgin ƙasa bisa sadarwa (CBTC); tsofaffin layuka suna riƙe sassa tsayayyu tare da na'urorin tsayar da jirgi.
rationale.7f286aec: EN 13803 yana ba da shawarar kimanin 55 mm/s ga ƙimar canjin ƙarancin karkatarwa (a duba sashen doka). Tsawo = gudu · ƙarancin karkatarwa / ƙima.
rationale.7f2a4d01: 400 m yana ɗaukar jirgin ƙasa mai sauri na 2 × 200 m; TSI INF yana bar wa ƙasa memba tsawon.
rationale.7f395061: Haskakawar gaban gini ta mataki na farko al'adar taswirar CNOSSOS ce da aka saba.
rationale.7fedd139: Tashoshin metro kimanin 0.8–1.5 km tsakaninsu a tsakiyar birni kuma mafi faɗi a yankunan waje.
rationale.8047e465: Babu ma'auni. An zaɓi palet ɗin MobSimLab don bambanci a kan taswirorin tushe masu haske da masu duhu; koren S-Bahn da shuɗin U-Bahn suna bin al'adar taswirar Jamus da aka saba.
rationale.80fd3030: Manyan rundunar layin dogo masu tsararrun tagogin gyara galibi suna aiki ƙasa da ƙimar bas.
rationale.8110bbb3: Wurin farawa don dabarar yawan fasinjoji; a maye da bayanan kason hanyoyin sufuri na yankin.
rationale.813aa6a2: TCQSM yana ba da lokutan hidimar fasinjoji ga ƙofofi masu faɗi a daidaice na kimanin 1–2 s ga kowane fasinja a kowace kwarara; matakala da biyan kuɗin mota suna ƙara su.
rationale.82f21440: Ababen hawan metro galibi ana ƙayyade su don kimanin 60 zuwa 100 m a layukan tafiya (ƙasa a gareji). Kewayo mai faɗi; a ɗauki ƙimar fayil ɗin abin hawa idan akwai.
rationale.839f353b: Ƙofofi kaɗan a kowace mita fiye da metro.
rationale.842c615e: Tsare-tsaren DC na suna na EN 50163; wayar sama ta 750 V DC ga sababbin tsare-tsaren tram, 600 V DC a tsofaffin hanyoyin sadarwa.
rationale.84562583: Hanyar gaggawa ta birni ko babbar hanya mai layuka biyu a kowace hanya tana ɗaukar kusan ababen hawa 1,000–2,500 a awa a kowace hanya a lokacin cunkoso; HCM yana ba da kimanin motoci 1,800–1,900 a awa a kowane layi a matsayin kwararar cikawa ta tushe, kuma fitilu da haɗuwar layuka suna riƙe kwararar awa ƙasa sosai da ninki biyu na haka. Ana amfani da ƙima ɗaya ga cunkoson safe da na yamma; a saita ƙirgar titi na kansa a shafin GIS.
rationale.8483bb7c: Layukan bas suna jawo ƙaramin kaso na mutanen da ke zaune kusa da su fiye da layin dogo.
rationale.84b50888: Sama da haka kusa da jami'o'i; ɗaliban kusa da tashoshi a ƙiyasin yawan fasinjoji jagora ne.
rationale.85210412: Motoci ba za su iya kaiwa ƙofa a yankin masu tafiya da ƙafa ba: direba yana ajiye mota a gefensa ya taka. Ana sikelin mintunan da kason tsawon titunan yankin da ke na masu tafiya da ƙafa, don haka yanki mai gajeren titin masu tafiya da ƙafa yana samun kaɗan.
rationale.8576fca8: Tafiye-tafiye biyu a kowace ranar aiki ta kimanin 21 tare da kaɗan a ƙarshen mako; canje-canje tsakanin layuka suna ƙirguwa a matsayin tafiya ɗaya a kowane layi a nan, wanda ke tura adadin sama.
rationale.85a7327a: ILO yana ƙiyasin kason kuɗin shigar aiki na duniya a ɗan fiye da rabin GDP; ƙimomin ƙasashe suna tsakanin kimanin 0.4 zuwa 0.6.
rationale.85c63891: Yankunan hidimar metro a manyan birane suna kai kason sufurin jama'a na kashi ɗaya cikin uku ko fiye.
rationale.85d9698b: Faffaɗan ƙima ta madadin tsakanin al'adar layin dogo (UIC) da ta bas (TCQSM).
rationale.85e5a435: 49 CFR 234.225 yana buƙatar aƙalla 20 s na gargaɗi; layukan dogo galibi suna ƙara 'yan daƙiƙoƙi don shinge su sauka, don haka ƙimar tsakiya ita ce 25 s. Ƙasashe suna saita lokutansu na kansu.
rationale.85eca9e8: Bas masu haɗin gwiwa na 18 m biyu zuwa huɗu.
rationale.8606f494: Galibi ana isa ta sufurin jama'a mai ciyarwa ko mota; yankin hidimar tafiya da ƙafa samfuri ne mara ƙarfi a nan.
rationale.861eaaae: CNOSSOS-EU Annex II 2.3.1, Hoto 2.3.a: tushe A a 0.5 m sama da fuskar kawunan layukan dogo.
rationale.86336836: EMU sama, DMU/wanda injin jan jirgi ke ja ƙasa.
rationale.868280c0: Akwatuna masu zurfi ko kogon da aka haƙa tare da dogayen ramukan matakala masu motsi; Transit Costs Project yana ambaton zurfi da girman tasha a matsayin manyan abubuwan da ke ƙara kuɗi.
rationale.872eb4c8: Ayyukan ƙasa na tushen layi na 300–350 km/h. Bankin Duniya (World Bank) yana sa HSR na China a kimanin US$ 17–21 miliyan a kowace km gaba ɗaya da layukan Turai a US$ 25–39 miliyan a kowace km; UIC yana ba da rahoton kimanin €45.5 miliyan a kowace km a matsakaici har da gine-gine.
rationale.87c024c7: Ƙarshen ƙasa na kewayon manyan tituna na RASt 06: titunan rarrabawa masu layi ɗaya a kowace hanya suna ɗaukar ababen hawa ɗari kaɗan zuwa kimanin 1,000 a awa a kowace hanya a lokacin cunkoso. Ana amfani da ƙima ɗaya ga cunkoson safe da na yamma; a saita ƙirgar titi na kansa a shafin GIS.
rationale.87e08b18: Daga wanda injin jan jirgi ke ja zuwa EMU.
rationale.88cddd96: Tram suna yin layi kusa-kusa a tashoshi amma dole su raba masu haɗa taragai.
rationale.88edd5b1: Debrezion da sauransu (2007): kimanin 4.2 % ga gidaje da 16.4 % ga kadarorin kasuwanci a yankin tashar layin dogo; Rennert (2022) ya sami −7.4 zuwa +9.6 maki a cikin fiye da shari'o'i 200. Daidaitawa ta hanyar sufuri ƙarama ce domin bita ba ta sami bambanci mai muhimmanci tsakanin BRT, jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi da metro ba.
rationale.8930ce39: Ana amfani da shi ne kawai idan hanyar ba ta da alamar maxspeed mai amfani. Manyan hanyoyin birni galibi ana iyakance su zuwa 80–100 km/h; na karkara sun fi sauri.
rationale.896e860d: Binciken samar da tafiye-tafiye yana ba asibitoci kusan tafiye-tafiye 10 zuwa 15 a kowane gado a ranar aiki, har da ma'aikata; asibiti mai gado 300 kimanin tafiye-tafiyen baƙi da marasa lafiya 1500 ne bayan an cire ma'aikata (da ake ƙirga su a matsayin ayyuka).
rationale.898e369d: Zirga-zirga a hannun dama a yawancin ƙasashe; ƙasar aikin ce ke saita shi (hagu misali a GB, IE, MT, CY, JP, IN, AU, NZ, ZA, HK, SG, TH, ID).
rationale.8a053923: Buƙatar sufurin jama'a tana kai ƙoli a cunkoson safe da na yamma; TCQSM yana ba da ma'aunan awar cunkoso da bayanan fasinjoji awa-awa inda awa mafi cunkoso ke ɗaukar kusan 8–13 % na fasinjojin rana. Mai kwaikwayo yana ba kowace awa ta tagogin cunkoso (07–09, 16–19) wannan kaso kuma yana yaɗa sauran ranar daidai a sauran awannin hidima.
rationale.8a07a206: Jiragen ƙasa tsakanin birane da injin jan jirgi ke ja ko masu ƙarfin kansu.
rationale.8a7d1260: Samfurin zaɓin hanya na Broach, Dill da Gliebe ga masu keke na Portland: mutane suna hawa hanyoyi masu tsawo sosai don amfani da hanyoyi da layuka daban. Hanyar keke (OpenStreetMap cycleway=track, ko layin keke da mai tsari ya yi masa alama a matsayin wanda aka ware) tana sa mita ɗaya ta ji kamar kimanin kashi uku cikin huɗu na mita.
rationale.8b0b52f9: Yawancin ƙasashe suna shigo da jiragen ƙasa da bas ɗinsu; sama inda ake gina su a cikin gida.
rationale.8bad379c: Ana amfani da shi ne kawai idan hanyar ba ta da alamar maxspeed mai amfani. Iyakar birni ta gaba ɗaya a yawancin ƙasashe 50 km/h ce.
rationale.8c4e9e74: Bas na 12 m: kimanin 5 kW tare da famfon zafi a yanayi mai sauƙi har zuwa kimanin 25–30 kW tare da ɗumama na juriya a ƙanƙara.
rationale.8cd595c7: Motocin bas na Class III na 12 zuwa 13 m suna ɗaukar fasinjoji zaune kaɗai, galibi kujeru 45 zuwa 57.
rationale.8cf6c361: Ana amfani da wurin ajiye keke a farfajiyar tasha ko kusurwar gaba; wanda ya fi nisa ba safai ba. Wuraren ajiye keke suna zuwa daga OpenStreetMap (amenity=bicycle_parking).
rationale.8e56c180: Ofisoshi da shaguna a yankunan tasha galibi darajarsu ta ɗan fi ta gidaje a kowace m².
rationale.8ebd723b: Bincike-bincike na Wardman (meta-analysis) na ƙimomin UK: ana ƙimanta jira a kimanin ninki 1.5 zuwa 2.5 na lokaci a cikin abin hawa.
rationale.90194718: 160 km/h tare da gefen jin daɗi (I = 100 mm maimakon 130).
rationale.90387906: Canji a tasha ɗaya baya buƙatar tafiya da ƙafa; tsakanin tashoshi na kusa fasinjoji suna karɓar 'yan mintuna da ƙafa, kimanin 400 m. Ana auna tafiyar da demand.mode.walk_weight kuma kowane canji da demand.mode.transfer_penalty_min.
rationale.9099964c: Yawancin gine-ginen OSM ba su da alamar tsayi. 8 m yana wakiltar gini mai benaye biyu zuwa uku; ƙarshen ƙasa (bene ɗaya ko rumfa) yana kare ƙasa, wanda shi ne gefen taka-tsantsan ga taswira. Kowane gini da ke aƙalla 2 zuwa 3 m sama da layin gani ya riga ya ba da yawancin kariyar rufin.
rationale.90efecaa: Ƙasa sosai da iyakokin kan lokaci (recording.late_threshold_s), don haka jadawali mai kwanciyar hankali ya dawo kan lokaci ga fasinjoji.
rationale.91702b0e: Canjin direba a ƙarshe; layukan atomatik sun fi gajarta.
rationale.91facdf0: Juyawar yanki ta yau da kullum.
rationale.9266ac90: Kewayon da aka saba na kuɗaɗen mai aiki da masu ba da shawara; Transit Costs Project ya sami isarwa mai yawan masu ba da shawara a ƙarshen sama.
rationale.92d25f50: Gudu mafi girma fiye da tram; 1000 m yana riƙe ƙaruwar gudu ta tsaye ƙasa da kimanin 0.5 m/s² a 80 km/h.
rationale.946f24ae: Mannewar taya da titi; tsaron fasinjoji, ba birki ba, shine iyaka ta zahiri.
rationale.947fa555: Mannewa ce ke iyakance shi a gudu.
rationale.949ba141: Karɓar kuɗin mota a waje da abin hawa da hawa ta dukkan ƙofofi suna rage lokacin tsayawa.
rationale.95650c34: Matsakaicin mutane a cikin mota a binciken tafiye-tafiye na ƙasa kimanin 1.3 zuwa 1.5 ne, ƙasa a tafiye-tafiyen zuwa aiki.
rationale.95b3615b: UIC 406 yana ba da shawarar kimanin 75 % a awar cunkoso a layuka masu gauraye da 60 % a rana; a duba ƙimomin da bugun yanzu.
rationale.95c67edc: 50 km/h ita ce iyaka ta gaba ɗaya a cikin wuraren da aka gina (StVO § 3(3)); garuruwa da yawa suna amfani da 30 km/h a titunan unguwa wasu ƙasashe kuma 60 km/h. Tram a layin da aka binne a titi suna tafiya ƙarƙashin dokokin zirga-zirgar titi (BOStrab), don haka iyakar titin tana iyakance gudunsu a can. OSM maxspeed ne ke aiki idan akwai.
rationale.96725448: Tushen layi da aka ware gaba ɗaya tare da shinge da rabewar matakin kowane titi; ba safai ba a matakin ƙasa.
rationale.9676067f: Matsakaicin tikiti guda-guda, fas da tafiya kyauta suna kai kimanin 1 zuwa 2 US$ (PPP) a kowane hawa a birane da yawa. An canza shi zuwa kuɗin aikin kamar teburan kuɗi.
rationale.96feca27: Ɓangaren lokacin mamayewa 'samar da hanya': 'yan daƙiƙoƙi ga haɗin kulle na lantarki, mafi tsawo ga haɗin kulle na relay; ana ƙara lokacin motsin makunni daga kundin makunnai a kai.
rationale.98062536: Kowane zagaye yana gudanar da dukkan samfurin, don haka daidaitawa tana ɗaukar ninki wannan adadin na gudanarwa ɗaya. Tsayayyun ƙimomin hanyar sufuri galibi suna natsuwa cikin zagaye uku zuwa biyar idan kasoshi kaɗai ne manufa.
rationale.984c0e4f: Nazari ɗaya ne, don haka sakamakon da ke amfani da shi ana yi musu alama a matsayin na nuni. Tsakiya: EIR na gondola na Placer County (2019, sashe 4.9) yana hasashen 62.6 dB(A) Leq a 100 ft (30.5 m) daga wuraren hasumiya, wanda shine 100 dB(A) a matsayin tushe na wuri ɗaya a kan ƙasa mai tauri (Lw = Lp + 20 log10 r + 8; canzawar MobSimLab). Sama: EIR ya ɗauki ma'aunin tasharsa (tashar ƙarshe ta kujerar kebul mai cirewa, 69.6 dB(A) Leq a 54 ft, 102 dB(A)) ga wucewar hasumiya ma, a matsayin mafi muni. Ƙasa: 10 dB ƙasa, hukuncin MobSimLab domin EIR da taƙaitaccen bayanin hayaniyar Burnaby Mountain Gondola (TransLink 2023, daga Hemmera 2020) duka sun ce wucewar hasumiya ta fi tashoshin ƙarshe shiru; babu ɗayansu da ya ba da adadi gare ta. EIR ya ce injinan gondola na gama-gari ne, don haka ƙimar na kowane tsarin kebul ne har sai wani tushe ya bambanta su.
rationale.98ee91e4: Bayan kimanin 500 m layin sufurin jama'a ba safai ba yake ɗaga mai karɓa sama da 45 dB L_den; ana gwada kewayon a gudanarwar gwajin hankali.
rationale.9a96ec6f: Ana gina tashoshi a daidaice, don haka layin da ke barin ɗaya a ƙasa mai gangare dole ya ɗauki bambanci tsakanin tsayin tasha da ƙasar da ke kusa da ita. Amfani da rabin mafi girman gangaren hanyar sufuri don wannan yana bar ɗaya rabin ga gangaren ƙasar da canjin ke wucewa a kai, don haka haɗawa kaɗai ba ta tura layi fiye da mafi girma ba. Kaso mafi girma yana ba da gajerun haɗawa amma layi mafi gangare kusa da tasha.
rationale.9b0f8d05: MAI RIƘE WURI: ba a karanta tushen wurin tsayawar jirgin ruwa (Euronoise 2018 paper 477, tashar jiragen ruwa ta Bilbao) ba tukuna; ba a iya isa shafinsa ba kuma takardar ba ta cikin aikin.
rationale.9b4cb134: Jagorar titi tana neman mashigai su kasance kusa da kusurwa madaidaiciya (digiri 90) gwargwadon iko, domin mashigar da ta karkata ta fi tsawo, tana riƙe ababen hawan titi a kan layi na tsawon lokaci kuma tana sa wa direbobi wahalar kallon tsawon layi. Gargaɗi ƙasa da 45° zaɓin masu kula ne da za a tabbatar. Ga tram masu tafiya a titi, layin da ke haɗuwa da titi a kusurwa mafi lebur ana ɗaukarsa a matsayin mai tafiya a tsawon titi, ba mai ketare shi ba.
rationale.9b95aafb: Faɗin hanyar tserewa da shigar ma'aikata kamar yadda ake amfani da shi a dokokin wurin aiki (kimanin 0.9–1.2 m).
rationale.9bb0a546: Fifikon fitilar tram a mahaɗai al'ada ce ta yau da kullum; dokokin titi na ƙasa ne ke yanke hukunci kan wuraren da babu fitila.
rationale.9bcf0b9a: Directive (EU) 2021/1226, Annex point (4)(b): tram +5 dB ga lanƙwasa da makunnai masu R ≤ 200 m.
rationale.9cc018d7: Tikitin birni guda ɗaya yana kai kimanin 2–3.5 € a biranen Jamus, Faransa da Italiya da kimanin 2.5–3 US$ a biranen US; a ma'aunan PPP ɗinsu wannan kimanin dala na duniya 2–4.5 ne. Birane a ƙasashe masu ƙarancin kuɗin shiga suna sa kuɗin mota ƙasa idan aka kwatanta da matakin farashinsu; 1.5 yana rufe su.
rationale.9cfe5e3f: Ana ƙara shi ga tafiya da ƙafa a layi madaidaici tsakanin dandamali biyu na tasha ɗaya har sai rail-model ya ba da lokutan daga dandamali zuwa dandamali daga tsarin tasha (ADR-0032, 06 §9.3). Kimanin hawan matakala ɗaya ko hawa lif; tashoshin metro masu zurfi suna buƙatar ƙima mai girma.
rationale.9dc27bb2: Al'adar Jamus: 4.00 m a layukan da aka inganta har zuwa 230 km/h, 4.50 m a sababbin layuka har zuwa 300 km/h, 3.50 m cikakkiyar mafi ƙanƙanta (EBO §10).
rationale.9dc4dafd: A bi al'adar babban layi ta ƙasa: dama misali a DE, AT, NL, ES, PL, CZ, US; hagu a GB, FR (ban da Alsace-Moselle), BE, CH, IT, SE, PT, JP. Tram da yawancin metro suna bin zirga-zirgar titi.
rationale.9e52f925: Tram a titi suna ketarewa a fitilun zirga-zirga, don haka zirga-zirgar titi tana jira ne kawai lokacin tsakanin kore (intergreen) bayan tram ya wuce (share yankin karo na tram tare da farkon koren titi), galibi 'yan daƙiƙoƙi. A tabbatar da lokutan alamar yankin.
rationale.9ec5a9a2: Ayyukan bas suna da kadarori masu gajeren tsawon rai (ababen hawa shekaru 12–15); shekaru 20 suna rufe sabunta ababen hawa. Hanyoyin sadarwa masu gauraye suna amfani da lokaci mafi tsawo na hanyoyin sufurinsu.
rationale.9f5bba9f: Gudun makunnan DB na yau da kullum (R 190 m 40 km/h, 300 m 50, 760 m 80, 1200 m 100) duka daidai suke da sqrt(100 · R / 11.8) da aka zagaye zuwa ƙasa, don haka layin karkata yana tafiya da kimanin 100 mm ƙarancin karkatarwa ba tare da karkatarwa ba. EN 13803 yana ba da izinin fiye tare da sharuɗɗa (a duba sashen doka).
rationale.a07b76af: Layin tafiya a titi da ke daidai da saman titi ba shi da karkatarwa; layin tram da jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi da aka ware galibi har zuwa kimanin 100–150 mm (BOStrab-TrR, a duba adadin).
rationale.a09e2d08: TCQSM: mafi ƙarancin hutu a tashar ƙarshe don maye gurbin direba da ramawa, galibi 5–10 min ko kimanin 10 % na lokacin zagaye.
rationale.a0b0e7c6: Tantancewa galibi tana riƙe kuɗin mota tsayayye a ainihin ƙima; wasu birane suna shirin ƙari sama da hauhawar farashi. Sassaucin kuɗin mota yana aiki ga canjin.
rationale.a0c3e4b7: Tashin babban layi galibi suna jinkirta minti ɗaya ko fiye; kashi ɗaya cikin uku na tafiye-tafiye da jinkirin farko zato ne na gwaji mai tsauri amma na yau da kullum.
rationale.a0d320aa: Ƙananan gudun layi suna buƙatar ƙarancin karkatarwa; jiragen ƙasa suna tsayawa a lanƙwasa a tashoshi.
rationale.a1556df4: Fas ɗin wata galibi yana kai kimanin kuɗin tafiya guda 20–40 (misali kimanin 30 a biranen Turai da yawa), don haka fas yana biyan kansa a kimanin tafiyar zuwa da dawowa ɗaya a yawancin ranakun aiki.
rationale.a27c08c5: Kuɗaɗen gudanarwa a kowace tarago-km na taragai ne na kimanin 25 m (taragan babban layi 24–27 m, taragan metro 18–23 m). Tarago-km na jirgin ƙasa shine tsawonsa bisa wannan ƙima sau km ɗinsa, don haka gajerun sassan tram masu haɗin gwiwa ba a ƙirga kowanne a matsayin cikakken tarago ba.
rationale.a37637f8: Sake gina titi daga gefe zuwa gefe da karkatar da bututu da wayoyi. Layukan tram na Faransa suna kai matsakaicin kimanin €25–30 miliyan a kowace km gaba ɗaya (Besançon €17.5 miliyan); kimanin kashi ɗaya cikin uku na haka ayyukan titi ne, an canza a kimanin 0.73 € a kowace $ na duniya (2023).
rationale.a3f71374: Tafiye-tafiye biyu a kowace ranar zuwa aiki sau kason ma'aikatan da ke zuwa aiki a matsakaiciyar ranar aiki (kimanin 0.8, bayan hutu, rashin lafiya, aikin rabin lokaci da aiki daga gida). Ma'aikata sune mutanen yanki sau ƙimar aikin yi ta ƙasa (World Bank) ga mutane masu shekaru 15 zuwa sama.
rationale.a44df481: Ƙafar keke da ke ketare layukan dogo a kusurwa mai lebur na iya faɗawa cikin gibin flange ko kwazazzabon layin tram kuma mai hawa ya faɗi; jagorar keke tana neman mashigai kusa da kusurwa madaidaiciya kuma tana ɗaukar mafi lebur fiye da kimanin 60° a matsayin haɗari da ke buƙatar sake daidaita hanyar. A tabbatar da jagorar ƙirar keke ta ƙasa.
rationale.a463593e: Ƙaruwa daga jama'a, ayyuka da girman hanyar sadarwa bayan buɗewa, kafin kowane canjin kuɗin mota; 0–2 % a shekara shine kewayon da aka saba a hasashen tantancewa.
rationale.a47496de: Tafiye-tafiye bayan wannan da kafin cunkoson safe suna ƙirguwa a jimillar ranar aiki kawai.
rationale.a47bca4f: 2001/290/EC yana iyakance karkatarwar ƙira a sababbin layukan jirgin ƙasa mai sauri zuwa 180 mm (an gani a tushe); EN 13803 da EBO §6 suna ba da 160 mm a matsayin iyakar da aka saba a layi mai tsakuwa da 180 mm a matsayin mafi girma (a duba).
rationale.a48cd3b6: Taragan metro suna kai kimanin US$ 2–3.5 miliyan a kowace tarago ta 20 m; jiragen ƙasa marasa direba a ƙarshen sama.
rationale.a5c94711: 0.4 · V² a 160 km/h kimanin 10,000 m ne; 0.25 · V² yana ba da mafi ƙanƙanta 6400 m.
rationale.a5ea12e8: Ɓangaren lokacin mamayewa 'gani da amsawa': lokacin da direba ke buƙata don ganin abin da alamar nesa ke nunawa ko wurin gani ya amsa; kimanin 0.2 min shine ƙimar tsari da aka saba.
rationale.a7c18f46: Ƙimar zane: rabin faɗin iyakar gini (kimanin 1.6–2.0 m daga tsakiyar layi ga babban layi, EN 15273) ban da rabin faɗin layi, tare da hanyar tafiya.
rationale.a873a97d: Nauyi daidai don farawa; nauyi zaɓin mai tsari ne ko masu yanke shawara kuma ana daidaita su don su haɗu zuwa 1.
rationale.a8bcb03b: I = a · s / g tare da s ≈ 1500 mm: 0.65 m/s² ƙaruwar gudu ta gefe mara daidaito (jin daɗi tare da fasinjoji a tsaye) yana ba da kimanin 100 mm; 1.0 m/s² yana ba da kimanin 150 mm.
rationale.a8e6418c: Nisan tsaro bayan alama mafi tsawo da faɗin tazarar layi a dandamali don dawowa zuwa tazarar layi.
rationale.a90ed278: Jiragen ƙasa masu ƙarfin wutar lantarki (EMU) suna kai kimanin US$ 7–10 miliyan ga 70–80 m.
rationale.a91d2aa9: Lokacin tsayawar layin dogo na TCQSM; tashoshin tsakiya suna kai ƙarshen sama.
rationale.a9c2170c: Hidimar birni da aka saba daga kimanin 05:30 zuwa 23:30 a tazarar lokacin layi.
rationale.a9d5eb8c: Layukan dogo suna da cikakken fifiko a mahaɗar daidai (Vienna Convention Art. 19).
rationale.aa2ea923: Samfura a NCHRP Report 716 suna auna lokacin da ba na injin ba a kimanin ninki biyu na lokaci a cikin abin hawa; tsayayyen ƙimar zaɓi na musamman yana ɗaukar sauran.
rationale.aaabeda8: Fitilun titi suna nuna 'yan daƙiƙoƙi kafin shinge su fara sauka; saukar tana ɗaukar kimanin 6–10 s; sannan ake tabbatar da mashigar a rufe.
rationale.abc307db: Tazarar da aka saba ta taswirorin dabaru na birni. Edita yana ƙara girman tarin ga layuka masu tsawo sosai don hanyar ta ci gaba da sake ƙididdigewa a kowane gyara.
rationale.ac093cbb: Direbobi da ATO suna birki ƙasa da ƙimar da kariyar ke kulawa, don haka tsayawa na yau da kullum ba sa taɓa lanƙwasar kariya.
rationale.ac2ae9c7: Yankunan haɗari biyu tare da faɗi mara cikas da sarari don matakala ko lif a tsakiya.
rationale.acb0cb00: Yawancin gine-ginen OSM ana yi musu alama building=yes kawai; ƙasa da wannan faɗin ƙasa ana ɗaukar su a matsayin gareji, rumfuna da kiosk kuma ba sa samun mazauna, daga tarin WorldPop ko daga girman gini.
rationale.acd3803b: Faffaɗan ƙima ta madadin a dukkan hanyoyin sufurin layin dogo; tsayin ƙasan ababen hawa na kundin bayani na kansa yana tsakanin 300 zuwa 1300 mm.
rationale.ad20bdf4: TSI PRM da EN 15273-3 suna ba da bq0 = 1650 mm a layi madaidaici ga dandamali 550 mm da 760 mm a faɗin layi 1435 mm (a duba); lanƙwasa suna ƙara faɗaɗa layi.
rationale.ad273cc2: Kamar gini; hidimomi suna da kason ƙarin ƙima kai tsaye mafi girma.
rationale.ad44a9d8: Sarari ga gangaren ƙarshen dandamali, alamar tashi da nisan tsaronta ko wuce iyaka zuwa tasha ta ƙarshen layi (buffer stop); ana kai tazarar layin a wajen tasha.
rationale.ad79c543: SBB yana ƙirga 3 min, UK PPM 5 min, DB 6 min (jinkiri daga 6:00 zuwa sama).
rationale.adf3626a: Ana ɗaukarsa kamar layin dogo inda mashigai ke da kariya; in ba haka ba fifikon fitila.
rationale.ae0c6357: Matsakaicin farashin gidaje a kowace m² raba da GDP ga kowane mutum: kimanin 0.03 a United States, 0.07 a France da Germany, 0.1 ko fiye a China da birane masu saurin girma. Faɗi da gangan; a shigar da ƙimar yanki inda aka sani.
rationale.ae8b99db: Jagorar US DOT tana ƙimanta tafiyar mutum ta cikin gida a 50 % na tsakiyar kuɗin shiga na awa.
rationale.aea67b82: Jiragen ƙasa na yanki a cikin kundin bayani suna tsakanin masu ƙasan ƙasa (495–780 mm) zuwa ababen hawan Birtaniya masu tsayin ƙasa (kimanin 1250 mm); 780 mm ya dace da dandamalin 760 mm da aka saba.
rationale.af400761: Birkin gaggawa na layin dogo ba tare da birkin layi ba.
rationale.afd81ec6: Ranakun digirin ɗumama galibi ana ƙirga su ƙasa da 15 °C.
rationale.b069e2e7: Copernicus GLO-30 samfurin saman ƙasa ne mai rufin gidaje da kawunan bishiyoyi. Ana cire samfura a cikin gine-ginen OSM, sannan buɗewar morphological a kan wannan taga (Zhang da sauransu 2003) tana cire duk abin da ya fi siriri da ke tsaye sama da kewayensa: sauran gine-gine, jerin bishiyoyi, gadoji. Tuddai da manyan tudun ƙasa masu faɗi fiye da tagar suna zama. Taga mai ƙunci sosai tana riƙe manyan gine-gine da dazuzzuka a matsayin ƙasa; mai faɗi sosai tana daidaita ƙananan tuddai.
rationale.b0852673: Tagar kan lokaci ta TCQSM: har zuwa 5 min jinkiri (wasu hukumomi suna amfani da 1–3 min).
rationale.b093361e: Sararin titi na kimanin 4.5–5.0 m (ma'aunan titi na ƙasa) tare da 1.5–2.0 m zurfin saman gada.
rationale.b0d83d3d: NCHRP Report 716 yana ba da ma'aunan gogayya na gamma ga manyan yankunan birni (f = a·t^b·e^(c·t), t a mintuna). t shine lokaci na gaba ɗaya tsakanin yankuna (logsum na zaɓin hanyar sufuri, a mintunan cikin abin hawa).
rationale.b158d99e: Farashin yanki (misali farashin Verkehrsverbund da yankunan Transport for London) suna ƙara kusan 30–60 % na kuɗin motar yanki ɗaya ga kowane ƙarin yanki.
rationale.b1ea3c77: US DOT yana raba kuɗin shiga na shekara da awanni 2080. GDP ga kowane mutum (World Bank, kuɗin cikin gida) yana tsaye a madadin kuɗin shiga, kamar a teburan fa'ida.
rationale.b211b00e: Iyaka mafi girma da magudanar kebul, hanyar tserewa.
rationale.b3709fa4: Faɗin layi na daidaitacce 1435 mm shine tsohon TSI; madadin da aka saba: 1000 (mita), 1067 (Cape), 1520/1524, 1600, 1668 (Iberian). Hanyoyin sufurin titi suna watsi da wannan ƙima.
rationale.b3ca5f5a: Manyan titunan birni masu fitila: kwararar cikawa ta kimanin motoci 1800 zuwa 1900 a kowace awar kore, sau kason kore na kimanin 0.5.
rationale.b3d89deb: Wayoyin bas mai waya biyu-biyu tare da turaku da tashoshin wuta.
rationale.b465f633: Alamar tashi da ɗan nisan tsaro a ƙarshen dandamali.
rationale.b48b6016: Bincike-bincike na Wardman (meta-analysis): tafiya da ƙafa zuwa da daga sufurin jama'a ana ƙimanta shi a kimanin ninki 1.5 zuwa 2.5 na lokaci a cikin abin hawa.
rationale.b5548e0c: Ana neman haskakawa ta mataki na farko a gaban gine-gine a cikin wannan nisa daga kowane mai karɓar taswira. 50 m yana rufe ɗayan gefen yawancin titunan birni da dandali; gaban gini mafi nisa yana ƙara kaɗan kusa da sautin kai tsaye, kuma bincike mafi faɗi yana rage saurin taswira.

rationale.bca5a22c: Nazari ɗaya ne, don haka sakamakon da ke amfani da shi ana yi musu alama a matsayin na nuni. Ma'aunan wucewar manyan jiragen ruwa na teku (ro-pax, 4.8–9.3 kn) a tashar jiragen ruwa ta Livorno. Takardun suna ba da ƙarfin sauti a kowace mita ta tushen layi, LW/m: 84.3 dB(A) (Fredianelli da sauransu 2020, Hoto 8) da 83.1 dB(A) bayan gyara don nisa da gudu (Nastasi da sauransu 2020, Hoto 6), wanda suka ce 'kada a rikita shi da matakin ƙarfin sautin jirgin da ke motsi'. Injin (engine) yana ɗaukar ƙarfin sautin jirgin kansa, don haka MobSimLab yana canzawa da Lw = LW/m + 10 log10(v T), sautin da ake ji ɗaya daga tushe na wuri ɗaya a gudu v kamar daga layin a lokacin matsakaita T: a 5 kn (2.57 m/s) da takarda ta farko ke ɗauka da matsakaicin wucewar jirgin ruwa na 109 ± 38 s, v T = 280 (182–378) m, yana ba da 108 dB(A) (105–112 tare da rashin tabbas na LW/m). Waɗannan manyan jiragen ruwa ne, don haka mai kayan ya zaɓa (2026-11-16) a riƙe mai riƙe wurin da ke ƙasa ga bas na ruwa, catamaran da hydrofoil har sai wani tushe ya rufe ƙananan jiragen ruwa. Nastasi da sauransu sun gano matakin yana ƙaruwa da gudu kamar 20.97 log10(v / 3.9 m/s); injin bai yi amfani da wannan ba tukuna.

rationale.e7c25a8d: Ƙananan bayanan Stockholm: 0.007 ga isarwa da aka auna daga gida da 0.015 ga ma'aikatan da ke canza wurin aiki; nazarin manyan biranen US sun sami ƙimomi mafi girma (sama).
rationale.e841e1af: Tafiye-tafiyen yanki suna farawa da ƙarewa a tsakiyarsa (an auna nauyi bisa inda mutanensa ke zaune) kuma suna haɗuwa da hanyar sadarwar titi a 'yan mahaɗai mafi kusa, don haka suna yaɗuwa a tituna da yawa maimakon loda ɗaya. rationale.e8464dde: 55 dB L_den shine mafi ƙanƙantar rukuni da Ƙasashe Membobi ke ba da rahoto ƙarƙashin END Annex VI; ana zana hanyar edita har zuwa gare shi (ADR-0038 §1).

rationale.e96434d7: Yawancin gine-ginen da ba a yi wa alama ba a OpenStreetMap gidaje ne ko gine-ginen gidaje masu yawa; sauran shaguna, ofisoshi da rumfuna ne.
rationale.e9c6e34c: Ababen hawan jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi suna da ƙananan gatari masu ƙarfin tuƙi fiye da tram kuma suna tafiya da sauri; 60 ‰ yana riƙe gefe ƙasa da iyakar tram.
rationale.ea0a6d1c: Hukumomi suna kashe kusan 5–15 % na kuɗin shigar mota kan sayar da tikiti, kula da injuna da ƙofofi, kuɗin kati da biya da dubawa; katunan zamani da biya a buɗe suna ƙarshen ƙasa.
rationale.ea102907: Yana daidai da ƙarshen ƙasa na kewayon sanyi kaɗan.
rationale.ea96caed: UN R107 yana ba da izinin 0.125 m² ga kowane fasinja a tsaye a bas na Class I (8/m², mafi girma na doka); tsari yana amfani da kimanin 4/m².
rationale.eac4685d: Layi ɗaya yana adana layukan dogo da wani ɓangare na tushen layi, amma ba magudanar ruwa, shinge da yawancin gine-gine ba.
rationale.eaecaab4: EBO §7 yana ba da 12.5 ‰ a manyan layuka da 40 ‰ a layuka na mataki na biyu; 25 ‰ layin yanki na fasinjoji kaɗai ne na yau da kullum.
rationale.ebbf059f: Mutanen da ba su da mota suna zaɓa tsakanin sufurin jama'a, tafiya da ƙafa da keke. rationale.ebddfe84: Layukan birni da bas ke amfani da su kimanin 3.25–3.50 m ne a jagorar Jamus (RASt 06); layin daidaitacce na US 12 ft (3.66 m) ne. A duba ƙimomin.
rationale.ec98e1f9: Kayan alamomi da na wuta galibi ana shigo da su.

rationale.ee58d215: Tafiya da gani, tashoshi da mahaɗai ne ke iyakance ta.
rationale.f073efe3: Tasha ɗaya a kowane ƙauye ko gari a kan layi.
rationale.f0c47218: Directive 96/53/EC Annex I 1.5: abin hawan titi dole ya juya a cikin da'ira mai rabin diamita na waje 12.5 m (na ciki 5.3 m). Ana amfani da shi a matsayin rabin diamitar mamaye na waje a gudun tafiya da ƙafa, ba a matsayin rabin diamitar tafiya ba.
rationale.f0d1086a: Titunan unguwa, marasa rukuni, na zama da na hidima: iya ɗaukarsu ba safai ba ce ke iyakance tafiya.
rationale.f0da04ec: Mafi girman gudun metro na yau da kullum.
rationale.f1f1fd45: Jagororin kuɗi da fa'ida galibi suna amfani da kimanin shekaru 30 ga layukan dogo da shekaru 25–30 ga sufurin birni (misali Jagorar CBA ta Hukumar Turai (European Commission), 2014, da aka ƙirga har da gini); MobSimLab yana ƙirga shekaru 30 bayan buɗewa. Zaɓinka ne — ana riƙe shi tsayayye a gudanarwar Monte Carlo.
rationale.f206d93c: Transit Costs Project yana bayyana kuɗaɗe a dalar PPP ta 2023. Teburan suna sikelin su zuwa shekarar baya-bayan nan da ma'aunin GDP deflator na US na Bankin Duniya (NY.GDP.DEFL.ZS) kuma zuwa ƙasar da ma'aunin canzawar PPP ɗinta (PA.NUS.PPP) ko, ga ababen hawa, farashin musayar kuɗinta (PA.NUS.FCRF).
rationale.f23a793a: Ƙimar farko da ba a daidaita ba: abin da lokaci da kuɗi ba sa kamawa (jin daɗi, amintuwa, ɗabi'a). Daidaitawa zuwa kason hanyoyin sufuri da aka lura yana maye gurbinta.
rationale.f381714c: Tazarar catenary na babban layi galibi 60–65 m ce a layi madaidaici kuma gajera a lanƙwasa; EN 50119 yana saita ƙa'idodin ƙira, ba tazara tsayayyiya ba.
rationale.f40c7586: Kuɗin motar yara galibi rabi ne; wasu birane suna bar yara su hau kyauta (rangwame na 1).
rationale.f5801ee9: Ayyuka na musamman na wayar sama galibi suna iyakance gudu.
rationale.f597297f: Buɗe kulle a tasha ko da waya, da ajiyewa a ƙarshe; fiye inda tashoshi galibi babu komai ko sun cika.
rationale.f6386271: Hanyar bas mai sabon shimfiɗa, masu rarrabawa da ayyukan mahaɗa, a kowace hanya.
rationale.f63fe63e: Titunan unguwa na RASt 06 (Wohnstraßen, Wohnwege) suna ɗaukar har zuwa kimanin ababen hawa 400 a awa a duk faɗin titi, yawanci ƙasa sosai; 50 a kowace hanya titi ne mai natsuwa da zirga-zirgar mazauna kaɗai. Ana amfani da ƙima ɗaya ga cunkoson safe da na yamma; a saita ƙirgar titi na kansa a shafin GIS.
rationale.f64d96dc: Kuɗaɗen cunkoso na gefe suna tsakanin babu a tituna masu kwarara kyauta zuwa fiye da 50 € cents a kowace mota-km a titunan birni masu cunkoso a lokacin cunkoso; 0.1 matsakaici ne na ilimi ga birni a cikin rana. Waɗannan ƙimomin Turai ne, an canza su daga euro na 2016 da ma'aunin PPP na yankin euro da hauhawar farashin US; a maye su da ƙimomin yankin idan kana da su, domin kuɗin gurɓata, haɗari da cunkoso sun bambanta sosai tsakanin ƙasashe.
rationale.f6bdae72: WHO 2018 yana ba da shawarar rage hayaniyar zirga-zirgar titi ƙasa da 53 dB L_den.
rationale.f6f1d0ae: Gudu mafi girma da ƙananan awannin ma'aikata a kowace km.
rationale.f700de2f: WHO 2018 yana ba da shawarar rage hayaniyar layin dogo ƙasa da 54 dB L_den.
rationale.f75eb917: Rami a buɗe ƙarƙashin titi (haƙa mai bango ko kwalliyar U ba tare da rufi ba), tare da magudanar ruwa da gadojin titi a kai; ana gina shi kamar kwalliyar gangare, don haka kewayo ɗaya da gangare tsakanin matakai.
rationale.f773289b: Tram suna ketare tituna a fitilun zirga-zirga; jirgin ƙasa mai sauƙi da na babban layi na iya riƙe mahaɗar daidai (rukunin haƙƙin hanya B). Iyakar gudun layi (level_crossing.max_line_speed_kmh) tana aiki kuma.
rationale.f804c90c: Bas na birni na daidaitacce 12 m yana da kujeru kimanin 30 zuwa 40 da sarari ga 30 zuwa 50 a tsaye a mutane 4/m² (mode.standing_density_ppm2); layukan dogo suna amfani da iya ɗaukar jirgin ƙasan kundin bayani da aka zaɓa maimakon haka.
rationale.fa04374a: Bincike-bincike na Wardman (meta-analysis): kimanin minti 5 a kowane canji, fiye inda canjin ba shi da daɗi ko ba tabbas; ana ƙirga tafiya da ƙafa da jiran canjin a kai.
rationale.fa1a9c0a: Binciken tafiye-tafiye na ƙasa sun sami kimanin tafiye-tafiye 2.7 (England) zuwa 3.4 (United States) ga kowane mutum a rana, 3.1 a Germany (MiD 2017). Tafiye-tafiyen gida–wasu kimanin 40 zuwa 50 % ne daga cikinsu.
rationale.faea1614: Ana sakin nisan tsaro bayan alama ta lokaci bayan jirgin ƙasa ya tsaya a gaban alamar fita (ko nan take idan an kulle hanyarsa ta gaba); kimanin minti ɗaya abu ne na yau da kullum ga haɗin kulle na lantarki.
rationale.fb2b48cb: Ababen hawan layin dogo suna aiki shekaru 25–40 (09-planning-models §3.1); mai kayan ya amince da shekaru 30 (2026-11-16).
rationale.fbed82a4: Tsarin lokaci-lokaci yana raba motsi masu karo a maƙogwaro da aƙalla lokacin saita hanya, kusanci da sharewa; 90 s ya dace da misalin tashar ƙarshe ta metro.
rationale.fc0f66e9: CNOSSOS-EU Annex II 2.3.2 (hayaniyar birgima): ana amfani da mafi ƙarancin gudu na 50 km/h ga jimillar rashin santsi mai tasiri, don rufe hayaniyar birki da ta bugu a ƙaramin gudu; ba ya canza kwararar ababen hawa. Ba a yin samfurin hayaniyar bugu ƙasa da wannan gudu.
rationale.fc31f705: Tashoshin kewayen birni 'yan kilomita tsakaninsu; mafi kusa a tsakiya.
rationale.fc53151e: Abin hawa mai haɗin gwiwa na 30–40 m.
rationale.fc6332a0: Tsakiyar birane suna jawo tafiye-tafiye fiye da yadda ayyukansu da shagunansu kaɗai ke nunawa (taruwar shaguna, al'adu, hidimomi). Yanki yana tsakiya idan mai tsari ya yi masa alama, ko idan ayyukansa a kowace km² sun kai demand.cbd_job_density_km2.
rationale.fd02d7c7: Ana amfani da shi idan OSM yana da building:levels amma babu height; ginin da ba shi da ko ɗaya yana ƙirguwa a matsayin benaye uku.
rationale.fd06e7f5: Tsohon END Annex I 19:00; ana iya gajarta lokacin yamma da awa ɗaya ko biyu tare da tsawaita lokacin rana ko dare daidai.
rationale.fd0b3b9c: Tashar bas ko tram mai suna kamar tashar layin dogo da ke kusa da ita wurin canji ne ko da ta fi nisan tafiyar canji na yau da kullum: ana raba sunayen tashoshi a cikin nisan haɗawa na 150 m na layin dandamali, don haka tsakiyar dogon dandamali na iya kasancewa mita ɗari kaɗan daga tasha. A rage shi inda tashoshin da ba su da alaƙa suke da suna ɗaya a kusa; a ƙara shi ga manyan tashoshi masu tashoshi a warwatse.
rationale.fd4a6ed2: Bitar shaidu ta DfT tana ba da rahoton matsakaicin sassaucin taruwa galibi tsakanin 0.02 da 0.05; ƙima mai girma tana rufe hidimomin kasuwanci a manyan birane.
rationale.fea93dd7: Haƙa mai bango (kwalliyar U) ko tudun ƙasa mai bango; tsakanin kuɗin matakin ƙasa da na haƙa da rufewa.
rationale.feddfe7f: Ana amfani da shi ne kawai idan hanyar ba ta da alamar maxspeed mai amfani. Iyakar birni ta gaba ɗaya a yawancin ƙasashe 50 km/h ce (30 mph a biranen UK da US).
rationale.fef618f9: Yawan ayyuka a kowane rukunin amfani (faɗin ciki na net ga kowane cikakken aiki) an ƙara su da kimanin 20 % don jimillar faɗin ƙasa da wuraren da babu kowa.
rationale.ff4818d0: Zaɓin mai kayan (2026-11-16): samfurin yana rufe layuka tare da gefe na 2 km. Wannan yana ɗauke da yankunan hidimar tafiya da ƙafa da keke na kowace tasha (mode.catchment_m bai wuce kimanin 1.2 km ba) da gajerun tafiye-tafiyen mota da ke gasa da layin. A yi amfani da fiye ga layukan da fasinjojinsu ke zuwa daga nesa (ajiye mota a tasha, layin dogo na yanki).
rationale.ff5e263c: Hanyar wurin nauyi mafi girma ta Ceder tana saita yawan tafiya don nauyin awar cunkoso a haɗi mafi cunkoso ya zauna a mamayewar da ake so; iya ɗauka yana ƙirga masu tsaye a yawan tsari, don haka ƙimomi kusa da 0.8 suna barin sarari ga nauyin da bai daidaita ba tsakanin jiragen ƙasa.
rationale.ff68efd7: CNOSSOS-EU yana sanya tushen layin titi 0.05 m sama da saman titi.
rationale.29fa358c: Hanyoyin ƙofa a gefe ɗaya na jirgin; ƙofar da mutane biyu za su iya wucewa jere ana ƙirga ta sau biyu. Tsarin lokacin tsayawa yana raba fasinjojin jirgi da su. An ƙirga daga tsarin taragai na yau da kullum, ba daga teburin tushe ba: taragin metro na m 20 mai ƙofofi biyu-biyu huɗu yana ba da 40 a kowace m 100, tram na m 30 mai ƙofofi biyu-biyu uku ko huɗu kusan 24, taragin yanki na m 25 mai ƙofofi biyu-biyu biyu 16, taragin tafiya mai nisa na m 25 mai ƙofa ɗaya ko biyu guda-guda 8.
rationale.dba93787: Fasinjoji suna taruwa a ƙofofin da suka fi kusa da hanyoyin shiga dandamali, don haka hanya mafi cunkoso tana hidima fiye da kaso daidai; tsayawa yana ci gaba har ta gama. TCQSM ya bayyana wannan amfani da ƙofofi mara daidaito; 1.3 ƙiyasi ne na hankali ga dandamalin da ake shiga daga wuri ɗaya ko biyu.
